verdict.rationale: Fellow ships an official, documented MCP Server (developers.fellow.ai/reference/mcp-server) that lets AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor query meeting transcripts and action items without code, with admin-level tool controls; a runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint (fellow.app/mcp) is live and properly bearer-gated as documented. missing for 10: independent third-party/community usage reports beyond the vendor docs and the single runtime probe.
